name: HeyCounsel
description:
HeyCounsel is a curated community of fractional, solo, and boutique lawyers. The HeyCounsel MCP brings HeyCounsel’s community, network, opportunities, and peer benchmarks into Claude.

You'll be able to catch up on what's been happening in Slack, search for other members in the HeyCounsel network, find the most relevant work opportunities for you, search for legal templates, see reviews on the tools and services most recommended by the community, gain insight into how your peers are structuring, running, and scaling their firms, and more.

What HeyCounsel members can do with this MCP:

• Community Discussions — Put the community's collective experience to work across years of member discussion. Search across 50,000+ messages; Catch up on the most active threads; search for best practices, recommendations for vendors and tools; check if your question has already been answered by an expert; and get recommendations for the best Slack channels to join given your practice.

• The member network — Search the member directory to find the right lawyer in the HeyCounsel community.

• Work opportunities — Browse legal work posted by other members and external clients and filter to opportunities you're a fit for.

• Legal Templates — Search HeyCounsel’s template library for agreements, forms, checklists, clause sets, and other reusable legal documents.

• Your profile — See how you show up in the community, check your profile completion, and get suggestions on what to improve.

• HeyCounsel Pulse — Benchmark your pricing, economics, tech stack, and more against aggregated, anonymized peer responses, filterable by firm size, practice area, and jurisdiction.

This HeyCounsel MCP requires an active HeyCounsel membership.

_published_faq.name: How do I add HeyCounsel to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add HeyCounsel to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.heycounsel.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the HeyCounsel MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: HeyCounsel provides these MCP tools: find_a_lawyer, get_my_heycounsel_profile, get_opportunity_detail, get_pulse_results, get_pulse_status, list_opportunities, list_slack_channels, list_top_slack_threads, search_slack_conversations, and search_legal_templates.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to HeyCounsel?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to HeyCounsel in legal on the Manufact MCP catalog include GVRN Company Incorporation MCP, Alizé, Ansvar AI, Casepoint, and CiteLaw.
HeyCounsel requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
HeyCounsel is developed by HeyCounsel. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
